description: Delete tag. Delete a workspace tag. Returns 409 while prospects still carry it unless `force=true`, which removes it from them first. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

force.description: `true` removes the tag from every prospect first.
